questions.question: If I _____ a million dollars, I would travel around the world.
If she spoke English better, she _____ that job.
Which sentence is a correct second conditional?
options: If I were you, I would study more.
If I am you, I would study more.
If I were you, I will study more.
If I was you, I study more.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would study more.
